ck_institution_memberships_time_range.name: ck_institution_memberships_time_range

ck_institution_memberships_active_end.name: ck_institution_memberships_active_end
ck_institution_memberships_active_end.detail: is_active = TRUE OR ended_at IS NOT NULL

ck_user_preferences_quiet_hours_pair.name: ck_user_preferences_quiet_hours_pair
ck_user_preferences_quiet_hours_pair.detail:
(quiet_hours_start IS NULL AND quiet_hours_end IS NULL)
            OR
            (quiet_hours_start IS NOT NULL AND quiet_hours_end IS NOT NULL)

ck_class_meeting_patterns_date_range.name: ck_class_meeting_patterns_date_range
ck_class_meeting_patterns_date_range.detail: valid_until IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until >= valid_from

ck_teacher_class_assignments_time_range.name: ck_teacher_class_assignments_time_range
ck_teacher_class_assignments_time_range.detail: ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= assigned_at

ck_class_enrollments_time_range.name: ck_class_enrollments_time_range
ck_class_enrollments_time_range.detail: ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= enrolled_at

ck_academic_activity_versions_published_.name: ck_academic_activity_versions_published_at
ck_academic_activity_versions_published_.detail:
publication_status = 'draft'
            OR published_at IS NOT NULL

ck_ai_model_versions_time_range.name: ck_ai_model_versions_time_range
ck_ai_model_versions_time_range.detail: retired_at IS NULL OR activated_at IS NULL OR retired_at >= activated_at

ck_activity_diff_assessments_time_range.name: ck_activity_diff_assessments_time_range
ck_activity_diff_assessments_time_range.detail: superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > assessed_at

ck_student_activity_states_priority.name: ck_student_activity_states_priority
ck_student_activity_states_priority.detail: personal_priority IS NULL OR personal_priority BETWEEN 1 AND 5

ck_student_activity_states_completion.name: ck_student_activity_states_completion
ck_student_activity_states_completion.detail:
activity_status <> 'completed'
            OR (completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_against_version_id IS NOT NULL)

ck_student_tasks_kind_source.name: ck_student_tasks_kind_source
ck_student_tasks_kind_source.detail:
(task_kind = 'activity_milestone' AND activity_id IS NOT NULL)
            OR
            (task_kind = 'personal' AND activity_id IS NULL)

ck_student_tasks_completed_at.name: ck_student_tasks_completed_at
ck_student_tasks_completed_at.detail: task_status <> 'completed' OR completed_at IS NOT NULL

ck_planner_recommendations_decision.name: ck_planner_recommendations_decision
ck_planner_recommendations_decision.detail:
recommendation_status = 'proposed'
            OR decided_at IS NOT NULL

ck_attendance_tokens_revocation.name: ck_attendance_tokens_revocation
ck_attendance_tokens_revocation.detail: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= issued_at

ck_attendance_scan_events_validated_at.name: ck_attendance_scan_events_validated_at
ck_attendance_scan_events_validated_at.detail: validation_status = 'pending' OR validated_at IS NOT NULL

ck_ai_generated_artifacts_scope.name: ck_ai_generated_artifacts_scope
ck_ai_generated_artifacts_scope.detail: student_id IS NOT NULL OR class_id IS NOT NULL

ck_assistant_messages_model_role.name: ck_assistant_messages_model_role
ck_assistant_messages_model_role.detail:
(message_role = 'student' AND ai_model_version_id IS NULL)
            OR
            (message_role = 'assistant' AND ai_model_version_id IS NOT NULL)

ck_assistant_message_sources_one_source.name: ck_assistant_message_sources_one_source
ck_assistant_message_sources_one_source.detail:
(activity_version_id IS NOT NULL AND material_version_id IS NULL)
            OR
            (activity_version_id IS NULL AND material_version_id IS NOT NULL)

ck_ml_model_versions_time_range.name: ck_ml_model_versions_time_range
ck_ml_model_versions_time_range.detail: retired_at IS NULL OR activated_at IS NULL OR retired_at >= activated_at

ck_ml_predictions_target.name: ck_ml_predictions_target
ck_ml_predictions_target.detail:
(student_task_id IS NOT NULL AND planned_session_id IS NULL)
            OR
            (student_task_id IS NULL AND planned_session_id IS NOT NULL)

ck_ml_predictions_value_shape.name: ck_ml_predictions_value_shape
ck_ml_predictions_value_shape.detail:
(prediction_type = 'completion_minutes'
                AND predicted_minutes IS NOT NULL
                AND predicted_minutes >= 0
                AND predicted_probability IS NULL)
            OR
            (prediction_type IN ('on_time_probability', 'session_completion_probability')
                AND predicted_probability IS NOT NULL
                AND predicted_probability BETWEEN 0 AND 1
                AND predicted_minutes IS NULL)

ck_ml_prediction_outcomes_one_value.name: ck_ml_prediction_outcomes_one_value
ck_ml_prediction_outcomes_one_value.detail:
(actual_minutes IS NOT NULL AND actual_boolean IS NULL AND actual_minutes >= 0)
            OR
            (actual_minutes IS NULL AND actual_boolean IS NOT NULL)

ck_sync_operations_resolution.name: ck_sync_operations_resolution
ck_sync_operations_resolution.detail: sync_status = 'pending' OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL
